{{Quote|We have a phase connector, but it's in the back room and has already been sold to a mining colony on Valashar.|Kazuda Xiono, to Teroj Kee while in the Office of Acquisitions|audio=XionoValashar-DangerousBusiness.flac|<ref name="Dangerous Business" />}}
'''Valashar''' was a [[Mid Rim Territories]] celestial body situated in the [[Churnis sector]]'s [[Valashar system]]. In [[34 ABY]], the [[Office of Acquisitions]] proprietors [[Flix]] and [[Orka]] sold a [[phase connector]] [[mining]] device to a [[Unidentified mining colony (Valashar)|mining colony]] on Valashar.

==Description==
Valashar was a terrestrial astronomical object<ref name="Dangerous Business" /> located in the [[Churnis sector]]'s [[Valashar system]] in the [[Mid Rim Territories]]. The celestial body was situated in grid square I-7 of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]].<ref name="Appendix" />

==History==
[[File:OfficeOfAcquisitions-TheRecruitPart2.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Flix and Orka (pictured) sold a phase connector to Valashar's mining colony.]]
By the time of the [[Cold War]] between the [[First Order]] and the [[Resistance]], a [[Unidentified mining colony (Valashar)|mining colony]] operated on Valashar. [[Flix]] and [[Orka]]—the proprietors of the [[Office of Acquisitions]] headquartered on<ref name="Dangerous Business" /> the Mid Rim [[planet]]<ref name="TG">''[[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge: Traveler's Guide to Batuu]]''</ref> [[Castilon]]'s [[Trantor-class supertanker fuel depot|supertanker fuel depot]] ''[[Colossus]]''—refused to sell a [[phase connector]], a rare and expensive type of [[mining]] device, to the First Order operative [[Teroj Kee]] due to his past attempts to [[Thief|steal]] from them. Instead, the pair sold the device to the mining [[Colonist|colony]] on Valashar. Flix and Orka kept the device in the back storeroom of their business and maintained a log of the sale in a database.<ref name="Dangerous Business" />

In [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{ResistanceDate|1|13}}</ref> when the [[Technician|mechanic]] [[Kazuda Xiono]] was briefly running the Office of Acquisitions while its owners were away, he told Kee that he could not sell him a phase connector, as the one they had was already sold to the Valashar colony. When Kee then attempted to [[Theft of the phase connector|steal]] it, Xiono was forced to destroy the mining device to prevent him from escaping offworld with the merchandise.<ref name="Dangerous Business" />

==Behind the scenes==
Valashar was mentioned in "[[Dangerous Business]],"<ref name="Dangerous Business" /> the thirteenth episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'' animated television series.<ref name="Insider 190">{{InsiderCite|190|Resistance Revisited|''Resistance'' Revisited}}</ref> The episode premiered on [[January 20]], [[2019]].<ref name="Disney Press">{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}}</ref>
